name: Nueva Carteya (Spain)
description: White field with a green saltire throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Nueva Carteya (a cross of Saint James, keys and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Nueva Carteya; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Nueva Carteya arms — cross of Saint James, keys and tree
